hero.title: Join the SAWO Team
hero.subtitle: Build Your Future with a Global Leader in Sauna Manufacturing

join.highlight: We are looking for individuals with prior experience in the sauna industry.
join.desc: SAWO is a trusted name in sauna manufacturing, blending Finnish expertise with skilled craftsmanship based in Cebu, the Philippines. Our team takes pride in producing high-quality sauna heaters, accessories, and complete sauna solutions for the global market.
join.cta: Do you want to work in the tropics? Join us and be part of an industry leader in sauna innovation!
